mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM CREATOR CR
JOIN MEMBER M ON CR.MEMBER_CODE = M.MEMBER_CODE
WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( M.NAME LIKE '%' || #{search.keyword} || '%' OR CR.ACTIVITY_NAME LIKE '%' || #{search.keyword} || '%' OR M.EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{search.keyword} || '%' OR M.PHONE LIKE '%' || #{search.keyword} || '%' )

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CR.OPERATOR_CODE AS WRITER_CODE, M.NAME AS WRITER_NAME, CR.ACTIVITY_NAME AS WORKSHOP_NAME, CR.ACTIVITY_REGION AS REGION, M.PHONE,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CLASS C WHERE C.OPERATOR_CODE = CR.OPERATOR_CODE ) AS CLASS_COUNT,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY CR.OPERATOR_CODE DESC ) AS RN
FROM CREATOR CR
JOIN MEMBER M ON CR.MEMBER_CODE = M.MEMBER_CODE
WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( M.NAME LIKE '%' || #{search.keyword} || '%' OR CR.ACTIVITY_NAME LIKE '%' || #{search.keyword} || '%' OR M.EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{search.keyword} || '%' OR M.PHONE LIKE '%' || #{search.keyword} || '%' )
)
WHERE RN BETWEEN #{search.startRow} AND #{search.endRow}

SELECT CR.OPERATOR_CODE AS WRITER_CODE,
M.NAME AS WRITER_NAME,
CR.ACTIVITY_NAME AS WORKSHOP_NAME,
M.EMAIL, M.PHONE AS MOBILE_PHONE,
CR.PROFILE_IMAGE,
CR.ACTIVITY_REGION, CR.SNS_URL,
CR.JOIN_DATE,
CR.SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT, CR.SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT_IMG,
CR.CREATOR_INTRODUCTION AS INTRODUCTION
FROM CREATOR CR
JOIN MEMBER M ON CR.MEMBER_CODE = M.MEMBER_CODE
WHERE CR.OPERATOR_CODE = #{writerCode}

SELECT #{writerCode} AS WRITER_CODE,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CLASS C WHERE C.OPERATOR_CODE = #{writerCode} ) AS CLASS_COUNT,
( SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM RESERVATION R
JOIN CLASS C ON R.CLASS_CODE = C.CLASS_CODE
WHERE C.OPERATOR_CODE = #{writerCode} ) AS RESERVATION_COUNT,
( SELECT NVL( SUM(CA.AMOUNT), 0 ) FROM CALCULATE CA WHERE CA.OPERATOR_CODE = #{writerCode} ) AS SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT
FROM DUAL

SELECT C.CLASS_CODE, C.NAME AS CLASS_NAME,
( SELECT LISTAGG( CO.OFFERING_NAME, ', ' ) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY CO.CLASS_OFFERING_CODE )
FROM CLASS_OFFERING_MAP COM
JOIN CLASS_OFFERING CO ON COM.CLASS_OFFERING_CODE = CO.CLASS_OFFERING_CODE
WHERE COM.CLASS_CODE = C.CLASS_CODE ) AS PERIOD_TYPE,
( SELECT MIN( CRR.OPERATION_START_DATE ) FROM CLASS_REPEAT_RULE CRR WHERE CRR.CLASS_CODE = C.CLASS_CODE ) AS RECRUITMENT_START_DATE,
( SELECT MAX( CRR.OPERATION_END_DATE ) FROM CLASS_REPEAT_RULE CRR WHERE CRR.CLASS_CODE = C.CLASS_CODE ) AS RECRUITMENT_END_DATE,
( SELECT MIN( S.MIN_PEOPLE )
FROM SCHEDULE S
JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE CRR ON S.REPEAT_RULE_CODE = CRR.REPEAT_RULE_CODE
WHERE CRR.CLASS_CODE = C.CLASS_CODE ) AS MINIMUM_PEOPLE,
( SELECT MAX( S.MAX_PEOPLE )
FROM SCHEDULE S
JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE CRR ON S.REPEAT_RULE_CODE = CRR.REPEAT_RULE_CODE
WHERE CRR.CLASS_CODE = C.CLASS_CODE ) AS MAXIMUM_PEOPLE,
C.PRICE, C.STATUS AS CLASS_STATUS
FROM CLASS C
WHERE C.OPERATOR_CODE = #{writerCode}
ORDER BY C.WRITE_DATE DESC, C.CLASS_CODE DESC
